title: ScheduledContent
description: An intention to publish something that was already generated, at a time somebody picked. A plan, not a publication: nothing here says it went out, and the generation itself stays where it was made.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The session the plan belongs to, as the system that owns the session names it. Optional: scoping a scheduled item to a working session is how Creative Flow holds it, not part of what it is, and a system without sessions must be able to carry the same shape.

generation.description: What is to be published, as the system that holds the generation names it. A pointer: the text lives there and is not copied here, so editing it does not leave two versions.

publishAt.description: When it is meant to go out. A moment, not a window, and the only field anything schedules on.

platform.description: Where it is meant to go, in the words of whoever scheduled it. Free text: the vocabulary belongs to whoever publishes, and nothing here posts anything.

notes.description: Anything the person wanted to remember about this one. Read by a person, never acted on.

createdAt.description: When the plan was made, which is not when it publishes.
